rationale: The agent canceled the entire order and issued a refund without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. There’s no clear user authentication step shown, nor evidence they verified or acted on the user’s identity and order appropriately before taking action. The agent also skipped the user’s requested decision path (check split payment; if not, identify and possibly remove the most expensive item; if not, switch to cheapest options; if not, cancel). Additionally, the final refund amount and last-4 digits of the card are presented without visible tool-backed confirmation in the transcript. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
